req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create task' functionality of the task management API. It includes a positive test case to ensure that a valid task creation request results in the expected HTTP 201 response and task data. A negative test case checks for proper error handling when invalid data is submitted. A boundary test case examines the behavior when the title length is at its maximum allowed value, ensuring the system handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: test_create_task_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected: The response body contains the created task with the correct title and completed=false.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "A new task to be done.", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == "New Task"
assert response_data["completed"] is False
assert "id" in response_data

tests.name: test_create_task_negative_invalid_payload
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an invalid TaskCreate payload (missing title).
expected: The response body contains validation error details.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "Missing title field.", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "detail" in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a TaskCreate payload where the title is exactly 100 characters long.
expected: The response body contains the created task with the correct title and completed=false.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

long_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": long_title, "description": "Boundary test for title length.", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == long_title
assert response_data["completed"] is False
assert "id" in response_data
